description: On the table in front of you there’s a small white round base with two upright rectangular blocks, set against a red backdrop. The left hand moves in to steady the round base while the right hand reaches from the right to grasp a loose rectangular block, tilts and lowers it into the base beside the other upright pieces, then adjusts it with small twists and presses so it stands aligned; the left hand keeps holding the base as the right hand releases and hovers nearby.
